projects.title: Green Call
projects.description:
With great honour and dedication we worked with GIZ on a project that is close to our hearts, and a theme that is becoming an urgent matter day by day: "waste management and the circular economy”. Together, we devised the campaign "Think green, act green." Using the colours of the Earth, we aimed to describe our planet through a unique symbol in the project's logo, creating an emblem presented in all the accompanying materials of this campaign.

We launched the campaign by organising an event with the support of the Ministry of Environment and Spatial Planning of Kosovo, the European Commissio…

projects.title: It's good to be an Albanian
projects.description:
Created for Tifozat Kuq e Zi

Logo design for "Tifozat Kuq e Zi", fans of the Albanian National Team, which has now become the identifying mark of all Albanian sports fans worldwide, and is used everywhere on flags, jerseys, t-shirts, hats, scarves and other equipment.
